Auditors Responsibilities for the Audit of the Standalone lnd AS Finaocial Results
Our objectives are to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the Standalone lnd AS

reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions of users taken on the basis of
these Standalone lnd AS Financial Results.
As part of an audit in accordance with Standards on Auditing, we exercise professional
judgment and maintain professional skepticism throughout the audit. We also:

basis for our opinion. The risk of not detecting a material misstatement resulting from

intentional omissions, misrepresentations, or the override of internal control.

we are also responsible for expressing our opinion on whether the company has
adequate internal financial controls system in place and the operating effectiveness of
such controls.
